point_order: sorted by integer affine coordinates (x,y) from the corrected ledger
hecke_row_policy: For each frozen fiber point, evaluate the degree-2 neighbor-x polynomial and mixed moments. Accept one row only when the complete three-point neighbor multiset is rational, uniquely reconstructed, contained in the frozen fiber, verifies the Hecke group sum, and passes finite-j modular-polynomial checks. Retain every other source status.
direct_control: Exhaust all distinct support-1, support-2 and support-3 signed group-law relations with the first coefficient +1 and subsequent coefficients in order [-1,+1]. Verify each row, retain all candidates and ranks.
